m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard! B... Bat? Ru... uugh.
Oh, hello, Bat. Wizard. Surprised to see me? I know you thought I'd be running around investigating your sabotage, but I'm too smart for that.
Perhaps. Or did we want you to think we thought that, knowing you'd overthink things, thus playing right into our hand?
No! It's what I said! It's my hand that's been played into! I have you right where I want you. Prepare to bear witness to my genius!
Your genius? All I see is a workshop full of stolen ideas. MY ideas. But what I don't see are any of your minions. Oh no! Did they desert you?
Meh. I've got new mini-
Wizard... Run! Stop yammering and just go!
SHUSH! Save your strength, Mellori. I'm going to need it. Hehehe. Now where was I? Oh, yes...
...Meh. I've got new minions now. Isn't that right, <ITALICS>Crew</ITALICS>? Ahehehehehe!
Yes, Master Medulla. We live to serve you. You are the smartest and toughest and most handsome boss that ever lived.
You mind-meddling monster! This ends now!
Ah, I love it when a plan comes together. Sorry yours didn't work out, Wizard. I mean, I'm not sorry. Obviously. Whatever. Let's just fight!
No! My Essence Cannon? What went wrong?
I knew you'd steal my Essence Cannon idea, so I forced myself to remember a fatal design flaw in case this exact scenario occurred.
You win this round, but the Cabal's victory is fated. Grandfather Spider's full power will be restored and this universe put out of its misery.
A deceptively wise man once said something to the effect of: you either go out a hero or live long enough to see yourself become the villain.
I am content with my destiny. As for you, Medulla, you've earned your fate too. Globulins, heal your Squid of this pathetic parasite!
This isn't over! The true hero of the Spiral will be revealed!
Great work, Wizard. Are you OK?
The Globulins are already taking back their home. We don't have much time! Is everyone alright?
Other than the herd of tuba-playing Helephants marching inside my head, I'm just swell.
Yes, we all feel quite awful. But it's a small price to pay to take down the Cabal. Right, Sparck?
Yes, Medulla. That was only a humorous joke. Got you. Ha!
No more... jokes. Help uggghh...
The Extractor is overloading! We need to restart the system so it can be properly powered down before it explodes and kills us all!
We'll have to work together: Crew, throw every switch and lever you see! Wizard, restart the Power Supply! Now!
Great job, everyone. This Crew represents everything good about the Spiral. You're all heroes! Especially you, Wizard.
But my father will never stop until he gets what he wants, and Mellori's a dangerous liability. I have to do this. I'm so very, very sorry.
Bat, NO! AAAAAHHHH No... aaahhh!*
*Cough* Bat's escaped! Again. After him! Quickly, everyone look for a statue! There's probably a secret passage!
Wait, Jim! Mellori's still alive, but not for much longer. Her biological makeup, it's half matter, half Magic. I don't know how to treat her.
We must return to the Arcanum; they'll know more about such things. Perhaps the Streamportal that Medulla used to reach Empyrea is here somewhere?
Let's hope so! Everyone look for the Streamportal!
The Wizard has found the Streamportal! I will input the coordinates for the Arcanum Dry Docks... Done!
The Globulins are multiplying! Time to go! Beans and I will grab the girl! Go! Go! Go!
Wizard! Sparck? What is the meaning of this?
My sweet little girl. Is she...
Mellori! What's happened to her?
Well, here goes nothing.
*AHEM* If you wish to enter this abode, you must first elucidate the access code. Ahehehehe!
Access code? Oh, right! Of course. The access code. Umm... the access code is... uh...
The access code is: I'm always around, but never seen. I'm often avoided, but you can't outrun meeee. What am I?
What? Oh, I see what's going on here. Hmm... Ah ha!
Death! You are... death.
Why, yes I am! Access granted! Bwwuuhahaahahaha!
*SIIGH* Keep your head on a swivel, kid. I get the feeling that wasn't Medulla's secretary.
C'mon. We have to go into the Central Axon to get to Medulla's Headquarters. Just be on your guard.
